secondary_chance_source_projection.scope: One existing secondary-output item; source probability-domain derivation, no RNG or recipe executed.

changed_item_click_source_projection.precondition: Valid survival user, installed abrasive, nine nonempty A clicks then distinct nonempty B, no intervening state mutations.
changed_item_click_source_projection.scope: Source control-flow derivation only; retain current per-item reset policy.

positive_scope: Normal enchantment XP uses summed minimum cost divided by two rounded up; source/current ordinary arithmetic corresponds. Curse and GT manual-tool exclusions exist; do not claim all disenchantment is absent.
Source and current disenchantment do not spend abrasive uses. Current ordinary successful sharpening spends one; source item retention is distinct from positive current world-saving hooks.

Twenty sharpening route declarations exist, including thirteen raw heads; target pulverization and overflow-safe unit arithmetic are already used. Route identities alone do not prove all gates, probabilities, materials or runtime registrations.

Current per-item click resets, registry-scoped enchantment holders, inherited material-enchantment flags and BigInteger overflow protection are kept. This audit does not restore legacy exploit or overflow behavior.
limits: Source/native consumer inspection only. Chance-domain counts, one click-path scenario, four fatigue values and four conditional type roles are not actual Java, RNG, player, recipe, item-drop, NBT roundtrip or game tests.

Normal unclamped exhaustion only; food-data cap, creative/invulnerable flags and external event changes are separate. Original external EU-item/curse-class heuristics do not prove required modern external compatibility.

No compile, Gradle, tests, game, build or push. Four sources changed only formatting; source/current raw hashes, ordered tokens/literal positions/comments/directives and user material hashes are separately revalidated.

Full final recipe table/overrides, exact material-form reachability, player permissions, GUI viewer button, renderer, high-effect extremes, old saves and independent process restart remain unverified.

root_revalidation.method: Rehash actual original/current/platform sources and native cached entries/javap bytes; trace item-save dispatch, sharpening chance construction/consumer, electric-tool type/assignment and ordinary exhaustion APIs; compare baseline snapshots and full code/literal/comment/directive views. No target, RNG, recipe, player or game execution.
